items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Sonny Payne, I remember seeing him when I was just starting out and I was just floored.

ctx.x: Well who were the people that influenced you, drummers, along the way?

Well in the big bands, when I was in high school, that was when I first started playing, I was really drawn to big bands and the Kenton band and of course Basie and Duke, all those guys. Sonny Payne, I remember seeing him when I was just starting out and I was just floored. I thought he was —
He had a lot of style, didn’t he?
